description: Renames a folder, or moves it into another folder or to the top level, with everything in it. Members of the folder it moves into get access to its reports. Needs manage on the folder, or owning it, and the same on the one it moves into. Answers the name and parent of the folder: getFolder gives who has access.

body.description: What the tool creates, changes or sends

name.description: The folder's name, as members will see it in Rollstack. Leading and trailing spaces are removed, and it can't be blank.

parentFolderId.description: The folder to move it into, by its `id` from `listFolders`, one you own or have `manage` on, and not the folder itself or one nested in it. Pass `null` to move it to the top level. Its reports, bursts and subfolders move with it.

idempotencyKey.description: A unique value, such as a UUID, that makes retrying this call safe. A retry with the same key within 24 hours answers the first call's result instead of running it again. Use a new key for each new call. From 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters.

params.description: The ids of what the tool acts on

id.description: The folder to act on, by its `id` from `listFolders` or `createFolder`.

name: updateFolder
title: Update folder
